title: Agent Pay actors and trust boundaries
caption: Five trust zones. The consumer and agent platform hold consent and the token; the edge and merchant verify signed requests; acquirers carry the payment; Mastercard registers agents, runs the key directory and issues tokens; the issuer decides. Verifiable Intent adds a signed chain alongside. The key directory location is not public.
alt: Flowchart. The consumer authorizes the agent platform with a passkey. The agent platform registers its key in the Mastercard key directory and gets certified, and requests an agentic token from the Mastercard network. The agent sends signed requests to the CDN, which fetches keys from the key directory, then forwards to the merchant. The merchant sends authorizations through the acquirer to the Mastercard network, which detokenizes and routes to the issuer. Verifiable Intent credentials flow from issuer to user to agent and are checked by merchant and network.

sourceOfTruth.label: Mastercard Developers: The Rails for Agentic Commerce
